name: harness
description: Harness — agent-first development toolkit. The `harness-antigravity` extension ships /harness:* slash commands, persona agents, and the harness MCP server for the Antigravity CLI (agy). Sibling plugins (`harness-claude`, `harness-cursor`, `harness-gemini`, `harness-codex`) target the other major AI coding tools.

plugins.name: harness-antigravity
plugins.description: Harness for Antigravity CLI (agy): every /harness:* slash command (commands/*.toml, read from ~/.gemini/commands/**), persona agents (agents/*.md, read from ~/.gemini/agents/*.md), and the harness MCP server (config/mcp_config.json). Unlike the Gemini CLI extension, agy natively supports persona agents. Lifecycle hooks are a deferred second phase (agy's stdin/stdout hook contract differs from Claude Code's).
